title: From Repositories to Training Environments: Scaling Long-Horizon Coding Agents with Environment Evolution Loop
abstract: arXiv:2611.21152v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Training coding agents for long-horizon tasks requires environments with verifiable feedback. Existing pipelines often follow a linear process that ends with validation, establishing usability but providing little guidance on improving training value. Recursive self-improvement (RSI) often requires model rollouts or model training followed by downstream evaluation, with costs and feedback delays amplified on long-horizon tasks. How can we use timely, reliable proxy signals to improve training value and synthesize environments at scale? We present RepoFactory, an automated pipeline that converts real repositories into verifiable environments where agents build complete projects from scratch given a language specification. Its Environment Evolution Loop optimizes a multiplicative objective combining validity, structural coupling, and implementation scope through proxy feedback. translated_title: 从代码仓库到训练环境：通过环境演化循环扩展长时程编码智能体
translated_abstract: 训练面向长时程任务的编码智能体需要具备可验证反馈的环境。现有流程通常遵循以验证为终点的线性过程，虽能确立可用性，但对如何提升训练价值缺乏指导。递归自我改进（RSI）通常需要模型推理或模型训练以及随后的下游评估，其成本和反馈延迟在长时程任务上会被进一步放大。如何利用及时可靠的代理信号来提升训练价值并大规模合成环境？我们提出了RepoFactory，这是一个自动化流程，可将真实的代码仓库转换为可验证的环境，在这些环境中，智能体在给定语言规范的情况下从零开始构建完整项目。其环境演化循环通过代理反馈，优化一个结合有效性、结构耦合度和实现范围的乘性目标。RepoFactory在17个软件领域中生成了10,159个环境。
tldr: RepoFactory提出环境演化循环，利用及时可靠的代理反馈自动将真实代码仓库转化为可验证的训练环境，并大规模生成了超过一万个人类可验证的编码智能体训练环境。
en_tdlr: RepoFactory introduces an Environment Evolution Loop that converts real repositories into verifiable training environments via timely proxy feedback, scaling to over 10,000 environments for training long-horizon coding agents.
